cards.front: 1. My parents decided _____ a taxi because it was late.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. to take.

Pattern: decide + to V.

cards.front: 2. It began _____ when I was in London last Saturday.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. to rain.

Pattern: begin + to V / V-ing. Trong các lựa chọn, “to rain” phù hợp.

cards.front: 3. I saw her _____ the street.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. cross.

Pattern: see + object + bare infinitive.

cards.front: 4. It's customary _____ a gift from at least once or twice before finally accepting in Japan.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. to refuse.

Pattern: It is + adjective + to V.

cards.front: 5. We've decided _____ the music contest at the end of this year.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. to attend.

Pattern: decide + to V.

cards.front: 6. We managed _____ their first album on social media.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. to find.

Pattern: manage + to V.

cards.front: 7. Don't let him _____ about his mother's illness now.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. know.

Pattern: let + object + bare infinitive.

cards.front: 8. It's dangerous _____ out alone late at night.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. to go.

Pattern: It is + adjective + to V.

cards.front: 9. My parents didn't encourage me _____ Music at university.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. to study.

Pattern: encourage + object + to V.

cards.front: 10. I’m happy _____ that you’ve passed your driving test. Congratulations!
cards.explanation:
✓ D. to hear.

Pattern: be happy + to V.

cards.front: 11. Blake didn't invite her boyfriend _____ to her graduation ceremony.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. to come.

Pattern: invite + object + to V.

cards.front: 12. The clerk required me _____ in the form before letting me in.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. to sing.

Pattern: require + object + to V.

Lưu ý: câu nguồn dùng “sing”, dù về nghĩa rất có thể intended word là “sign”.

cards.front: 13. I allow my little daughter _____ with her friends in the flower garden.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. to play.

Pattern: allow + object + to V.

cards.front: 14. He didn't deserve _____ by the locals like that.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. to be treated.

Pattern: deserve + to V. Ở đây cần dạng bị động: to be + V3.

cards.front: 15. It's impolite _____ off your shoes before stepping into a Japanese house.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. not to take.

Pattern: It is + adjective + not to V.

Ý nghĩa: bất lịch sự nếu không cởi giày trước khi vào nhà.

cards.front: 16. Jimmy forgot _____ the house, so it was broken into.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. to lock.

forget to V = quên làm việc cần làm.

cards.front: 17. Anna learnt how _____ cakes from her grandmother.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. to make.

Pattern: how + to V.

cards.front: 18. They intended _____ Paris last year but they didn't have enough time.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. to visit.

Pattern: intend + to V.

cards.front: 19. John made me _____ a lot with his hilarious jokes.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. laugh.

Pattern: make + object + bare infinitive.

cards.front: 20. Nothing can make Alex _____ her mind now.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. change.

Pattern: make + object + bare infinitive.
